correctness.rationale: For each rooted vertex v, P/Q/R track v omitted with 0/1 selected descendant neighbors or selected. Every child clique block B rooted at v yields L00/L01/L1. When v omitted, the clique may contain at most one selected child: zero case multiplies ∏(P_w+Q_w), one case ∑_w R_w ∏_{u≠w}P_u; when v selected, a mixed selected/omitted set of children violates the P3 constraint, leaving ∏P_w+∏R_w. The given update recurrences enumerate exactly those disjoint cases; induction on the block-incidence forest proves the full multivariate polynomial, and each incidence is processed O(1) times. Independent direct-subset evaluation confirmed windmill formulas for t<=4,m<=4 where bounded, and exact local clique logic was reconstructed; numerical checks do not substitute for induction. Univariate O(n^3) refers to naive coefficient arithmetic, not bit operations.
residual_risks: Expanded multivariate polynomial can have exponentially many monomials; linear bound is circuit arithmetic operations only.
